ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$4.09 in Ryde vouchers (RydeTAXI metered-distance overcharge for the unexempted petrol-station detour per RD-2; no waiting-time adjustment as fare already includes it).

segment_findings.reason: Latent west-east loop off the SLE east of Woodlands (21:37–21:39: trace via 1.4276,103.7964 / 1.4264,103.7984 / 1.4242,103.7965 vs quoted route via 1.4275,103.7958 → 1.4169,103.8034) adds ~1.0 km. RD-5: the driver's petrol-stop request came at 21:43:35, after this segment began, so the rider's 21:44:10 consent does not cover it; RD-4: no traffic incident and no band 1–2 on the replaced route. Unexempted per RD-1/RD-2.

Same loop repeated 21:47–21:50 around 1.3943,103.8327 / 1.4005,103.8279 off the TPE alignment, adding ~1.1 km over the quoted route. The rider agreed only to a 'quick petrol stop', not to a route change (RD-3(b)/RD-5); the stop was never made and the agreed location was not named. No RD-4 traffic justification (incidents empty; bands 4–5 only). Unexempted per RD-1/RD-2.

Residual excess beyond the two loops (fare.distance_km 19.31 vs route 17.253 km and mapped segment totals; ≈0.8 km of extra mileage on the Woodlands–SLE approach not matched to a single loop). Not covered by any RD-3 stop request (driver's route change was announced after the fact, if at all) and not excused by RD-4; counted under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver statement says the agreed 'short stop' justified a 'small change of route'; RD-3(b)/RD-5 reject this — the rider agreed to a stop, the driver chose the location without telling the rider beforehand, and the diversion began before the 21:44:10 consent.
RD-4 not met: no LTA incident (incidents empty) on the replaced route, and the only speed bands present (4 and 5) are well above the band 1–2 congestion threshold, so no exemption.
FARE-2 not triggered — tolls field is S$0.00; no ERP/toll overcharge to refund.
The unperformed petrol stop creates no separate refundable item; under RD-3(c) the non-stop yields no waiting charge and the metered waiting line is already S$0.00.
